text:
You're giving too much, too fast. Stop.

You text her instantly. You say yes to everything. You're easy to reach.

The moment you're easy to get, you become worth less.

Rare things cost more. Abundant things cost nothing.

Watch the guy who takes six hours to respond. People wait. He's got options. Nobody chases him.

You're not failing because you lack game. You're too available.

Stop texting first. Stop triple texting. Make your attention worth earning.

Easy to reach, easy to forget. Impossible to reach, impossible to ignore.
caption:
Nobody wants what they can have anytime.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
